tldr: The Sun through the 10th house brings attention to career, visibility, reputation, pressure, and ambition.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 10th house, it brings attention to career, visibility, reputation, pressure, ambition, authority, and how you are being seen. You may notice how much attention is on your responsibilities, your public role, or the direction you are trying to build.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a visible choice with more intention.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is measuring your whole self by what is productive, impressive, or approved.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
